dedupe_keys.name: northern ireland railways nir railway network

description: This dataset maps the railway network of Northern Ireland Railways, about 220 route miles of line. It contains the lines to Dublin, Bangor, Larne, Londonderry, Portadown and Newry, and Portrush, and the network serves 17 staffed stations and 5 staffed halts. It is published by OpenDataNI for the Northern Ireland railway operator. Coverage is national for Northern Ireland. The data are free under the Open Government Licence and can be downloaded as SHP and GeoJSON; the record was last modified in April 2023. Caveats: it is a line layer last changed in 2023, so later network changes may be missing. The network supports rail network flow and connectivity models, exposure of lines to flooding and coastal hazards, and resilience studies of cross-border links. It complements the GB railway network model and is related to NaPTAN, which lists the stations.
name: Northern Ireland Railways (NIR) railway network
provider: Translink / Northern Ireland Railways, via OpenDataNI
